record.question: Measurement of what parameter is useful in determining the metabolic or respiratory acidosis or alkalosis?
record.explanation: Answer D: All of the above. Blood pH identifies acidemia/alkalemia, while electrolytes (especially bicarbonate) and renal testing help characterize metabolic causes and renal contribution. “All of the above” is the best inclusive choice, though pH plus PaCO₂/HCO₃⁻ on blood gas is the direct way to classify the primary respiratory/metabolic disturbance. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK541123/; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK507821/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
